exposure: Caesarean sections performed by associate clinicians vs. all caesarean sections
Presence of MDGHTMs (Medical Doctors with postgraduate training in Global Health and Tropical Medicine)
outcome: Proportion of unsupported indications for caesarean section
cohort: Women giving birth in a rural Malawian hospital
finding: The presence of MDGHTMs in a rural Malawian hospital was associated with a significant decrease in the caesarean section rate and the proportion of unsupported indications for caesarean section.
